notes.title: Lady In Tomb's first promotion costs only $7.45.
notes.content:
As an ancient tomb adventure puzzle game with Chinese traditional cultural characteristics, Lady In Tomb will not be absent on this day! We have prepared two gifts for you. Let's have a look:

1. Lady In Tomb 's full version of the first discount promotion is opened. The original price is 68 yuan, and the current price is only $7.45!
The promotion will be launched on October 28, which is equivalent to a 30% discount. At the same time, the three DLCs just released this month will also continue to be given free, which is equivalent to $7.45 = Main game + 3 DLCs! Buying is making money.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/01c2fc08b4ed51d89069f685eca5f112d28831fb.jpg[/img]
2. Halloween special edition will be released on the 27th. Let's go to the grave and "knock out" the pumpkin heads!
Halloween is less "strange". These Soul Seekers in the ancient tombs also wear pumpkin hats to disguise themselves and run out in the middle of the night to scare people.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/dcd8f9a5f9303519522b2c3dd8bae20415eec6c0.png[/img]
And the more they enter the depths of ancient tombs, the more rampant they are.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/64bed249d02c5ec47481c1eddce96872c3af8526.png[/img]
You must protect yourself and never be... Er
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/76bbc1532e4a6a8b086d267c02a5ffa35bd3366d.png[/img]
Is there a kind of "harvest" joy in the pumpkins everywhere after beating? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/041e5b30749cfe48c0e77a86e4f76675318adb19.png[/img]
Finally, Magyu studio wishes everyone a happy Halloween and a happy game! Thank you for your love for Lady In Tomb.

notes.title: Shooting experience update
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

Here comes the new update.

This update focuses on the combat (shooting) part of the game. The goal is to make everyone have a smoother and refreshing combat experience. The contents of this update are as follows:

1、 Tiger wasp shooting feel Optimization: including Gu Jiuxun’s "Tiger Wasp", EA special weapon "Spirit Spider", Miao Mo's pistol, so as to make them have better shooting accuracy and feedback.

2、 Submachine gun shooting feel Optimization: the effect is the same as above.

3、 Grandpa's beloved baby "Sarah Jean" shooting feel Optimization: Sarah Jean 's range and power are enhanced to a certain extent, making it easier to burst heads, cause damage and hard straight effect to monsters, and better match the power setting of "shotgun".

4、 Optimized shooting feel of quantum jammer: longer range.

5、 Monster overall logic optimization: the monster has more hard straight actions, and the hard straight time will be extended appropriately.

7、	At the same time, new filter effects are added: we provide six filters: normal, pale blue, deep red, dark green and black-and-white. After entering the game, you can click "ESC" to enter the "pause menu" for selection. The picture effect is as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/d551d459dde5b11fbeb7f9c2290446bd9f4b74f8.jpg[/img]

Wish all of players will enjoy this version!

notes.title: The different after eat the Gu medicine
notes.content:
Dear players,

Apologize for failing in achieving the expected results of gameplay guidance, especially after taking the Gu Medicine, the guidance for the key Gu skill was not effectively explained.

We are now working on conceiving a new guidance for players to better and more easily understand the important information in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/7033b14c5e193231d00803722ca95a21121b6f2f.png[/img]

[b] After taking [Gu Medcine], Jiuxun will be empowered with the Gu skill "Shake the Soul", 3 effects will be achieved:
1. Frighten the ordinary Lost Souls and make them temporarily incapacitated
2. Frighten the Li Gui (Ghost Soldier), making them temporarily unable to move
3. Destroy the energy shield of "E" so that it can be attacked[/b]

[h3][u][b] How to use Gu skill: press and hold the [Space bar] to get into the Gu skill preparation state, and then click the [left mouse button] to confirm the release of "Shake the Soul"[/b][/u][ /h3]

Li Gui (Ghost Soldier) is the most mysterious Lost Souls. The traditional Gu skill cannot inflict fatal damage to them. Please explore more in the game to find a way to destroy it.

notes.title: The Final Version will Launch on 22th July
notes.content:
22th July, we will release the new version of “Lady in Tomb”.

[b]The Functions of the new version：[/b]
1. 3 new areas with new backstory；
2. Update the arts；
3. Update the music；
4. New CGs；
5. Avatar for Jiuxun；

Thanks for your interesting, hope you having a nice game time.

notes.title: Lady in Tomb - Upgrade Announcement -8th June

notes.content:
